reading: The Leonid meteor shower starts this weekend.
Its meteors look like lines of light that move quickly across the sky.
It will be strongest on the night of 17 November.
You may see as many as 15 meteors in an hour.
Experts say to find a safe, dark place away from street lights.
You can see the meteors with just your eyes.
Give your eyes about 20 to 30 minutes to get used to the dark.
An open space gives you a wide view of the sky.
You need clear skies to see the meteors.

vocabulary.definition: a time when many lines of light can appear in the night sky
lights along a road that help people see at night
a place outside with lots of room and few things in the way
a sky with few or no clouds
